pkgmetadata.longdescription: DS5Dongle turns a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W (or selected compatible boards) into a Bluetooth bridge for the DualSense controller, exposing it to the host as a wired USB gamepad with HD haptics and headset audio. This package installs the upstream prebuilt UF2 firmware and the HID configuration helper. It does not cross-compile firmware from source.

use.flag: Install alternate UF2 builds for Raspberry Pi Pico W and Waveshare RP2350B-Plus-W boards
